context_files_read.purpose: Confirm repository bootstrap and automatic phase boundary.
key_findings: The automatic loop stops after P13.
P14 is not automatic and must remain outside L06 execution.

context_files_read.purpose: Apply controlling safety and evidence rules.
key_findings: P03 and later real evidence must come from the wrapper gates, not project tests alone.
Missing metrics must be encoded explicitly and fake-only evidence must not be presented as real.
Host network, firewall, route, and interface mutation is forbidden.

context_files_read.purpose: Confirm phase-loop and CLI contract constraints.
key_findings: Required real gate wrapper commands use python3 -m valkey_scale_lab.cli underneath.
P14 requires explicit user opt-in and environment variable; L06 must not propose running it.

context_files_read.purpose: Map L06 surfaces to existing phase gates and artifacts.
key_findings: P03, P04, P05, P06, P07, P08, P10, and P11 provide the small-real real-Valkey surfaces.
Each surface has required phase_summary, valkey_e2e_evidence, cleanup_report, and scenario-specific artifacts where applicable.
P07 uses fault_safety_gate.py and P08 uses fault_failover_gate.py.

context_files_read.purpose: Use the required subagent JSON response contract.
key_findings: harness_architect must design tests, schemas, CLI gate, artifact validator, and real/fake evidence boundaries.
Output must be a JSON file under the stage subagents directory.

context_files_read.purpose: Apply previous-harness baseline and artifact-first policy.
key_findings: Stage harness should prioritize schema validation, artifact validation, fake deterministic tests, real Valkey e2e gates, and report golden tests.
Real evidence must verify Valkey 9.1.x, node count, cluster state or expected fault state, data path, cleanup PASS, and schema validation.
1000+ real execution is prohibited by default.

context_files_read.purpose: Read the L06 goal and acceptance criteria.
key_findings: L06 must make the six-node real scenario a parity control group before large-cluster expansion.
Required surfaces are cluster smoke, management ops, workload smoke, observability smoke, fault sandbox, failover primary stop, stability soak, and cleanup.
Fake tests and real six-node gates both need harness coverage, and reports must distinguish measured, missing, and skipped.

context_files_read.purpose: Reuse stage-specific prior context and risk notes.
key_findings: Existing coverage reports already show small-real coverage but L06 must audit parity at artifact level.
P07 and P08 contain skipped data-path or missing split-brain semantics that must be preserved.
Fresh real gates may require Docker resources; static artifact audit alone is insufficient if freshness is required.
The response allows only the top-level keys used in this file.
verdict must be APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, or BLOCKED.
Committed artifact audit validates required phase artifacts, schemas, gate results, metadata, and historical mismatch allowlists.
L06 should build on artifact-level validation rather than rendered report views.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect metric extraction and coverage layering.
key_findings: Existing builder extracts small-real metrics from P03-P11 artifacts and records missing/skipped semantics.
P08 split_brain_duration_ms is already modeled as an explicit missing metric.
The existing real evidence validator assumes cluster_state_observed ok and allows data_path_result SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
Rendered HTML, CSV, and SVG are views over JSON source artifacts.
Renderer rejects measured metrics sourced from rendered views.
Missing metrics CSV preserves status and reason.
Each metric must include source artifact, source hash, source pointer, evidence layer/class, real coverage flag, dry-run flag, and missing semantics.
Allowed value statuses include MEASURED, PASS, FAIL, MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and NO_BASELINE_YET.
Coverage layers distinguish fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run.
Entries must not count 1000 dry-run as real coverage.
Real evidence requires real_valkey, Valkey version prefix, probe result, nodes observed, cluster state, data path result, probes, and cleanup.
data_path_result may be SKIPPED_WITH_REASON but must remain explicit.
P03, P04, P05, P06, P10, and P11 valkey_e2e_evidence artifacts report real_valkey true, status PASS, six nodes observed, cluster_state_observed ok, data_path_result PASS, and Valkey 9.1.0.
P07 valkey_e2e_evidence reports real_valkey true, six nodes observed, cluster_state_observed ok, and data_path_result SKIPPED_WITH_REASON for the sandbox fault safety scenario.

P08 primary-stop failover evidence reports real_valkey true, five nodes observed after the stopped primary, cluster_state_observed ok, and data_path_result SKIPPED_WITH_REASON; the harness must verify six-node starting topology separately from the state artifact.
P08 failover_report summary encodes split_brain_duration_ms as MISSING with reason not_measured_by_primary_stop_gate.
All sampled cleanup_report artifacts have status PASS and empty resources_remaining.

findings.description: Existing coverage artifacts mark small-real surfaces as covered, but L06 needs a dedicated parity audit that proves fake fixture expectations and real six-node artifacts are checked by the same extraction contract.
evidence: codex/loop_engineering/04_STAGE_MANIFEST.md L06 acceptance requires fake tests and real Valkey six-node gate coverage.
scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py currently produces a broad cross-stage matrix, not a focused small-real parity audit artifact.

findings.description: Failover evidence has a special real boundary: primary-stop evidence observes five live nodes after the fault, so L06 must require six-node initial state plus expected post-fault semantics instead of blindly enforcing nodes_observed == 6 on P08.
Split-brain duration is not measured by the primary-stop gate and must remain an explicit missing metric in the parity audit and rendered report views.
evidence: AGENTS.md requires missing metrics to be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, never invented.

proposed_harness.name: schemas/artifact/small_real_parity_audit.schema.json
proposed_harness.acceptance: Schema requires schema_version v1, artifact_type small_real_parity_audit, stage_id L06_SMALL_REAL_SCENARIO_AUDIT_PARITY, producer, created_at, status PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED, source_artifacts with sha256, surfaces, metrics, report_checks, fake_real_parity, real_valkey_boundary, findings, and summary counts for measured, missing, skipped, fake-covered, real-covered, cleanup-pass, and blocking findings.

proposed_harness.name: scripts/audit_small_real_scenario_parity.py
proposed_harness.acceptance: CLI reads only JSON/JSONL source artifacts from P03, P04, P05, P06, P07, P08, P10, and P11 plus existing loop report JSON sources; validates schemas; computes sha256 for every source; emits artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/small_real_parity_audit.json; exits nonzero on blocking findings; never reads rendered HTML/SVG/Markdown as metric source.

proposed_harness.name: tests/audit/test_small_real_scenario_parity.py
proposed_harness.acceptance: Unit tests use temporary fixture artifacts to prove the builder fails on missing real evidence, wrong Valkey version prefix, fake-only real claims, absent cleanup PASS, missing source sha, rendered report metric source, and missing/skipped metrics without reasons.

proposed_harness.name: tests/coverage/test_small_real_metric_parity.py
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests assert all eight L06 surfaces have both fake fixture coverage and small-real coverage, use the same normalized metric names where applicable, and include required metrics: real_evidence.nodes_observed, real_evidence.cluster_state_observed, real_evidence.data_path_result, cleanup.resources_remaining, management operation durations, workload qps/latency/errors, observability cluster/docker/valkey samples, fault safety booleans, failover latency/promotion/split_brain_duration_ms, and stability duration/leak/restart/workload metrics.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_small_real_parity_report.py
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests render or inspect report-source artifacts and prove measured, MISSING, and SKIPPED_WITH_REASON values appear as distinct classes in JSON-derived CSV/HTML/SVG outputs; split_brain_duration_ms must appear as MISSING with its source artifact and reason, while P07/P08 skipped data-path semantics remain skipped rather than failed or fabricated.

proposed_harness.name: tests/real_valkey/test_small_real_gate_contract.py
proposed_harness.acceptance: Contract tests verify the real boundary without running P14: P03, P04, P05, P06, P10, and P11 require real_valkey true, status PASS, Valkey 9.1.x, six nodes observed, cluster_state_observed ok, data_path_result PASS, and cleanup PASS; P07 requires six nodes and sandbox-only safety with data_path_result SKIPPED_WITH_REASON allowed; P08 requires a six-node state artifact, primary stop observed, promotion observed, post-fault live nodes at least five, data_path_result SKIPPED_WITH_REASON allowed, and split-brain metric explicitly MISSING if unmeasured.

proposed_harness.name: tests/ci/test_small_real_parity_gate.py
proposed_harness.acceptance: CI test invokes python3 scripts/audit_small_real_scenario_parity.py --root . --out artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/small_real_parity_audit.json --require-fake --require-real --validate-report-views, validates the output against small_real_parity_audit.schema.json, and asserts status PASS for committed artifacts.

proposed_harness.name: .github/workflows/github-coverage-gates.yml small-real parity step
proposed_harness.acceptance: Workflow runs the L06 parity script and tests after existing audit, provenance, metric coverage, P13/P14, and report rendering gates, preserving the no-P14-real-execution boundary.

proposed_harness.name: fake-vs-real fixture parity checks
proposed_harness.acceptance: Fake deterministic fixtures under tests/fixtures/small_real_parity or inline tmp_path fixtures cover the same surfaces and normalized metric names as the real artifacts, but every fake metric has evidence_layer fake, evidence_class fake, real_valkey_coverage false, and cannot satisfy the real surface requirement.

proposed_harness.name: report source-of-truth guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Parity audit records report_checks proving report_index.json, metric_catalog.json, coverage_matrix.json, and small_real_parity_audit.json are source artifacts, while index.html, CSVs, SVGs, and Markdown are source_of_truth false views; measured metrics sourced from rendered views are blocking findings.

implementation_plan.step: Define the focused L06 audit schema.
implementation_plan.rationale: A dedicated schema prevents L06 from being satisfied by broad coverage_matrix rendering alone and gives future stages a stable small-real control-group contract.

implementation_plan.step: Implement a small-real parity audit builder and validator.
implementation_plan.rationale: The builder should normalize metrics from machine-readable artifacts, verify source hashes and schemas, and fail fast on real/fake evidence boundary violations.

implementation_plan.step: Encode the exact surface map in the builder.
implementation_plan.rationale: Use P03 cluster_smoke, P04 management_ops, P05 workload_smoke, P06 observability_smoke, P07 fault_sandbox, P08 primary_stop_failover, P11 stability_soak_smoke, and cleanup reports from all real phases. Include P10 only as an additional orchestrated-localhost real boundary metric, not as a replacement for P03 cluster smoke.

implementation_plan.step: Add fake fixture parity tests before relying on real committed artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: Fake fixtures should prove deterministic extraction, status semantics, and failure modes without Docker, while remaining unable to satisfy real_valkey coverage.

implementation_plan.step: Add real committed artifact contract tests for the eight L06 surfaces.
implementation_plan.rationale: These tests should validate committed real evidence artifacts and gate-result linkage without re-running Docker unless the validation agent explicitly runs wrapper gates.
Report tests must prove JSON-derived views distinguish MEASURED, MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and NO_BASELINE_YET and never become source-of-truth.

implementation_plan.step: Wire the L06 gate into CI without weakening previous gates.
implementation_plan.rationale: The dedicated parity gate should run alongside existing audit, provenance, coverage, and report gates so regressions are visible in CI.
The small-real audit should be the L06 machine-readable product, with existing catalog, matrix, and report outputs refreshed only by scripts and only as views or derived artifacts.

acceptance_criteria: The L06 parity audit schema validates artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/small_real_parity_audit.json.
All eight required L06 surfaces have fake fixture coverage and real small-Valkey coverage recorded separately.
Real coverage is satisfied only by wrapper-produced artifacts with real_valkey true, Valkey version prefix 9.1., PASS status, schema-valid probes, live endpoint evidence, and cleanup PASS.

P03, P04, P05, P06, P10, and P11 real evidence require six nodes observed; P07 requires six nodes plus sandbox-only safety; P08 requires a six-node starting state and post-primary-stop evidence with at least five live nodes, promotion observed, and cleanup PASS.

Every real scenario contributes normalized metrics with source_artifact, source_sha256, source_pointer, scenario, node_count_scope, evidence_layer small-real, evidence_class real_valkey or source_artifact, value_status, and missing_semantics.
split_brain_duration_ms remains MISSING with reason not_measured_by_primary_stop_gate unless a future real split-brain measurement artifact exists.
SKIPPED_WITH_REASON values are preserved for P07/P08 data-path and safety/fault windows and are not silently converted to PASS or MISSING.
Report checks prove measured, missing, skipped, and no-baseline states are visually and machine-readably distinct.
Rendered report files are never used as measured metric sources.
No L06 harness proposes or runs P14 real execution or treats 1000-node dry-run artifacts as real coverage.
The stage-specific CI gate runs after previous audit, coverage, provenance, and report gates without deleting or weakening existing assertions.
risks: A naive node-count assertion would incorrectly fail P08 after primary stop; the harness must check initial six-node topology separately from post-fault observed live nodes.
Existing coverage_matrix PASS could mask missing small-real parity details; L06 needs its own artifact with per-surface fake and real records.
Report rendering might accidentally source values from HTML or CSV views; the builder and tests must reject this for measured metrics.
Docker resources may be unavailable for fresh wrapper runs; if freshness is required and wrappers cannot run, validation should mark the stage blocked rather than accepting stale or fake evidence.
Refreshing loop report artifacts can change generated files; command logs and source hashes must make the refresh reproducible.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run or propose P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN real execution.
Do not count fake fixtures as real_valkey coverage.
Do not treat rendered HTML, SVG, Markdown, or CSV report views as source-of-truth metric artifacts.
Do not convert split_brain_duration_ms from MISSING to zero or PASS without a real measurement source.
Do not require P08 nodes_observed == 6 after the primary is stopped; require six-node initial state and explicit post-fault semantics instead.
Do not weaken existing schemas, tests, scripts, phase manifest requirements, gate locks, or historical gate results.
Do not mutate host network configuration, firewall, routing, interfaces, or unrelated processes.
Do not handwrite PASS into gate or parity artifacts; produce them through scripts.
commands_to_run: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m compileall -q src scripts tests
notes: L06 should be implemented as a focused artifact-first parity audit over the committed six-node real surfaces, with optional fresh wrapper validation handled by the validation agent if resources are available. The design intentionally excludes P14 execution and preserves P08 split-brain as explicit MISSING until directly measured.
